_doc: ELEM-S81 canonical legacy core recipes for gen_core_kit_legacy.py. Key = plan hard-core module (or plan_module). ref_tile from results/signoff_1024/inventory.json (bksel_q: the hk2l kit whose views closed; l5: the n32 kit at 1766568f01 = main's binding). Defaults: util = spec route.pd, CTS args of VQ r12, hold margin 15, fanout 24. 10-25 (S81-CORES/LEGACY): qbank_N/S + sstn_base566 ft1_pairs dropped: main RTL (dc23a738f / e7390b932) lands every station input in its own pin register (2 flops per bit, +1 cycle), so no one-station pair exists and canonical face_guard needs none. dsfd_rstg / ot_s81_sstn_payload536: relay2 (0c1b14693) 2-flop stations, suffix r2, no ft1_pairs.

dsfd_rstg.note: CLOCK-RESET/relay2 10-25: main RTL is the 2-flop station (S81-KITS-RTLC dc23a738f, +1 edge priced in gen_plan_v4 FRAME_BAND_STATION_EDGES); no one-station pair (rejected 10-24 20:42), canonical face_guard

ot_s81_sstn_payload536.note: CLOCK-RESET/relay2 10-25: main RTL is the 2-flop station (S81-KITS-RTLC dc23a738f, +1 edge priced in gen_plan_v4 FRAME_BAND_STATION_EDGES); no one-station pair (rejected 10-24 20:42), canonical face_guard

dsdv_gunit_l5_n32.why: KITS-SPARE/L5 10-25 structural successor of the l5_n32 legacy kit (GEOM-REVIEW-3 06:20 FAIL-F5/F3/F6): F5 regional taps 2x2 (one per SRAM row-pair x column-half quadrant, count split, trunk + H-tree, taps <=20 ps); F3 one macro tap per SRAM (wclk + rclk + its interface registers, hung from its region node); F6 SRAM interface registers anchored at the pin edge facing the logic channel (cols x43/x173 -> E edge, x302 -> W edge: the E edge is 7 um from the core boundary); pin registers: face_flops corner-column clamp (vi_n[32:38] had no slot). Modern flow (RCX RC, per-corner vclk, FF-only GRT hold, rtl_lint, reg_fanout).

rtl_patches.why: KITS-SPARE/L5 10-25 rtl_lint (yosys -noautowire): g_lv[LV].v referenced from inside generate block g_two is resolved as an implicit net \v (default_nettype none from the preceding dsdv/sinkhorn files). The default frontend elaborates it correctly (checked: same s/c), so the patch only hoists the reference into one module-scope wire v_last; s and c are bit-identical (yosys equiv on ot_hdc_sk_csa + gunit bench).

KITS-SPARE/L5 10-25 rtl_lint (yosys check -assert): the loop variable 'integer k' is assigned in two always blocks -> 32 'multiple conflicting drivers for k'. Second block gets its own loop variable j; the flops (v / s shift stages) are unchanged.
